title: Post the design to GitHub issues in this change?
context: When a team's tickets live in GitHub, should this change also post the design to the GitHub issue, or only to Jira, Microsoft Teams and Slack for now? Without it, GitHub teams (this project included) see the design only in chat and the build carries on without the team's sign-off. The plan already lists a small GitHub destination profile (More detail inside a details block).
